newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Live sales compared to last test on Wednesday - Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Trade mostly slow. Demand light, instances moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings current.
